A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same A-Mem system. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support reliable matching despite reformatting and appendix reorganization.

before.justification: v7 reports original LoCoMo evaluations across six foundation models, component ablations, retrieval-parameter experiments, and memory visualizations.

after.justification: v10 retains these original experiments and adds DialSim results, evaluations with three additional foundation models, and measurements of memory usage and retrieval time.

M1.justification: Note construction, link generation, memory evolution, and retrieval remain unchanged in Equations 1–10. The prompt templates in v7 Appendix C match those in v10 Appendix B. Additional evaluations do not introduce a revised method.

E1.justification: v7 evaluates conversational QA only on LoCoMo. v10 additionally evaluates DialSim, covering substantially longer, multi-party dialogues derived from television shows (Section 4.1 and Table 2). This broadens the represented conversational environments; the original LoCoMo coverage remains.

E2.justification: All matched LoCoMo experiments retain LoCoMo, ReadAgent, MemoryBank, and MemGPT as comparators. Added experiments reuse these methods: LoCoMo/MemGPT for DialSim and additional backbones, and MemoryBank/ReadAgent for scaling. No new comparator method or removal from a retained comparison is established.

E3.justification: v10 adds DeepSeek-R1-32B, Claude 3.0 Haiku, and Claude 3.5 Haiku configurations (Table 7). Its scaling experiment controls memory content while varying collection size from 1,000 to 1,000,000 entries and measuring storage and retrieval time. Original LoCoMo metrics, prompts, and retrieval settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: New Section 4.6 and Table 4 systematically examine storage and retrieval scalability against MemoryBank and ReadAgent. Section 4.3 also adds processing-time and cost analysis. The original component ablations, retrieval-parameter sweep, t-SNE analyses, and QA example are retained.

E5.justification: v10 Table 4 introduces retrieval-time measurements with ± values, absent from v7. Neither the meaning of these values nor the repetition count is specified. This adds uncertainty reporting without establishing additional runs for existing experiments.

E6.justification: The original LoCoMo tables and ablation values match across versions. v10 adds substantial results: DialSim F1 is 3.45 for A-Mem versus 2.55 for LoCoMo and 1.18 for MemGPT; Table 7 adds three backbones; Table 4 and Section 4.3 add storage, timing, and cost figures. These are new results, not same-setting improvements over v7.

T1.justification: The method definitions and metric equations remain mathematically equivalent. Section 4.6 describes observed storage scaling as O(N), but supplies no new formal derivation, theorem, proof, or assumption; this accompanies the empirical scaling interpretation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: autonomous note construction, dynamic linking, memory evolution, and improved long-term conversational performance. Their stated six-model evaluation claim remains unchanged despite additional supporting experiments.

C2.justification: v10 expands efficiency interpretations to deployment economics, negligible additional storage overhead, and scalability to one million memories. It also describes token usage per memory operation where v7 discussed answering questions, without clarifying that scope change. Existing mechanism explanations and Section 6 limitations remain.

D1.justification: v10 changes the advertised benchmark and production-code repository targets and removes the AIOS integration link. It newly reports processing times for GPT-4o-mini and locally hosted Llama 3.2 1B on a single GPU. Original embedding, retrieval, software, and prompt details are retained.

R1.justification: v10 adds references for DialSim, DeepSeek-R1, and Claude model documents. It removes the largely duplicated detailed-related-work appendix and associated general LLM, recommendation, and graph citations. The central positioning against fixed memory systems and agentic RAG remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Most existing prose is retained. Baseline descriptions move from Section 4.3 to Appendix A.1, the redundant related-work appendix disappears, and the results discussion gains performance and cost subheadings. Citation style, affiliations, and some wording and model-name errors are revised.

P2.justification: v10 replaces the colored title panel and running-header design with a narrower preprint layout, substantially resizing and reflowing figures and tables. It adds Tables 2, 4, and 7 and consolidates appendix displays. The original five figures retain their underlying content.

improvement.justification: v10 modestly strengthens evidence beyond the original LoCoMo study through DialSim and three additional foundation models while preserving the earlier results. Scaling measurements add useful practical information, but undefined uncertainty values, underdescribed timing procedures, and unclear accounting between tokens per answer and per memory operation limit the strength of the new efficiency claims.
